reuse.why: Uses getFillableCategories, batchMessages, setBudget and the undoable mutator, but computes last month's spending with its own SQL instead of reading the existing per-month sheet cell sum-amount-<cat> via getSheetValue as getCategoryAverage does.

duplication.why: Repeats the income-skip and expense sign-flip loop of set3MonthAvg and re-writes the on-budget alive-transaction SQL join already present in getFirstActivityMonth.

placement.why: Action lives in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts next to its siblings, though raw spending aggregation in the action layer bypasses the sheet layer.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable, but a second definition of 'category spending in a month' (SQL vs sheet sum-amount) can drift from the budget sheet's own rules.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts setLastMonthSpending: SQL over v_transactions_internal_alive instead of getSheetValue(sheetForMonth(prev), 'sum-amount-'+id)

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated income-skip/sign-flip loop and transaction SQL are plain copies, not disguised.
